Rule_or_Definition: Illustrative demo policy for order-level credit decisions; not validated underwriting.
On-time payment rate >= 90%; average days late <= 3; overdue balance <= ₹500; established history; positive available credit.
On-time payment rate >= 75%; average days late <= 7; overdue balance <= 10% of credit limit; established history; positive available credit.
If payment history is missing, recommend COD/prepaid until at least 3 completed orders have been reviewed. Missing history is not the same as bad payment behaviour.
If overdue balance >= ₹5,000, pause automated credit and route to COD/prepaid or human review.
If overdue balance is unknown, do not extend automated credit until verified.
If approved credit limit <= ₹0, require upfront payment unless a human approves a limit.
max(0, credit limit - overdue balance). Production should subtract all outstanding credit exposure and pending orders, not just overdue balance.
min(order value, available credit). Any amount above approved credit is required upfront.
1 only when the policy grants a positive 7- or 14-day credit amount; otherwise 0.
Required for COD/review cases, partial credit, credit holds, new stores, missing data or exceptions.
This deterministic policy is separate from the ML prediction. ML risk scores must never override hard guardrails. All records and labels are synthetic.
